pulse.currentFocus: S290 completed the recovery-to-closeout arc and exhausted all eight audit items plus second-order release innovations. Supabase REST, management, SQL, and Function authority now report independently; privacy-safe identity/control-plane receipts feed a proof-bound production interlock; dual-audience status surfaces expose the same truth; default Lighthouse advice is freshness-bounded; and canonical staging can be candidate-green only when its deployed build beacon exactly equals the candidate SHA. Implementation SHA cbf33a1898a1889bdcd29a593295a6345f9ff443 passed remote Lighthouse, Accessibility, E2E compliance, and secret lint, while production paths evaluated the hold and skipped mutation. Full build-check is 218/218, Worker/Obelisk 47/47, exact compliance 29/29 plus stress 40/40, staging 2/2 plus 29/29, data integrity 57/57, and Doctor blockingFailing=0. Production remains held because Supabase is 1/4 authority-ready and real-provider signed-in callback/session/role/revocation evidence remains absent.
pulse.nextMilestone: Restore Supabase management/SQL/Function authority, apply the archive migration, deploy Eternal Intelligence, compile a privacy-safe real-provider callback/session/member/investor/revocation trace, then run a fresh independent release gate before any production promotion.
blockers: The Supabase authority receipt is 1/4 ready: REST is HTTP 200, while management API, SQL migration, and Edge Function authority need an approved token or database/function credential through the secrets gateway.

The archive migration and Eternal Intelligence update are not deployed; authenticated Archive/Eternal tests and a real-provider Obelisk callback/session/member/investor/revocation journey must pass before production promotion.

next: [S260][SIL][PROCESS/P2] Generalize active-sink guards from specific TT rows to freshness-ranked input — DONE S261. Analyzer emits `.cache/tt-active-local-sinks.json`; guard consumes it and proves active-local unresolved rows are 0.
shipped: Recovery boundary was separated cleanly: scaffold commit c00b32eb2 and recovery closeout a302458ba were pushed before S290 began. No half-written JSON/NDJSON or config corruption was found; the recovered build was 218/218 and Doctor blockingFailing 0.

Shipped all 8 ranked audit items plus the trust-reviewed Sharp manifest remediation: fixed the remote consent-fixture false-red; split four Supabase authority planes; rendered a privacy-safe identity receipt; bound promotion to both runtime receipts; surfaced human/agent migration truth; made default Lighthouse evidence freshness-aware; bound candidate-green to exact deployed SHA; and kept strict CI checks unchanged.

Verification: full build/check 218/218; Worker/Obelisk 47/47; exact compliance 29/29 plus two-worker stress 40/40; staging release 2/2; staging compliance/game 29/29; data integrity 57/57; control-plane 8/8; identity receipt 7/7; promotion gate 11/11; staging parity 16/16; release proof 10/10; Lighthouse advisory 23/23; Doctor 14/15, overallPass=true, blockingFailing=0.

Exact implementation SHA cbf33a1898a1889bdcd29a593295a6345f9ff443 is pushed. Remote Lighthouse, Accessibility, E2E compliance, secret lint, sitemap, minification, brief format, and CI beacon passed. Pages, cache purge, and Sentry production workflows evaluated the hold and skipped mutation.
Canonical staging serves the exact candidate SHA and reports candidateReady=true / shaBound=true. Latest atomic static snapshots are 20260724201411 and 20260724201451. Production was not promoted.
The dependency update bot's only red was Sharp below 0.35.0 in scripts/package.json; package trust scored the official 0.35.3 release APPROVE 86/100, and the manifest now requires ^0.35.3.
